title: Malware Analysis & Forensics

Successfully extracted C2 URLs and identified obfuscation techniques used by attackers.

Executed a full incident response playbook including log analysis, memory forensics via ANY.RUN/Hybrid Analysis, and the identification of post-exploitation activities like shadow copy deletion and UAC modification.

features.title: Log Correlation
features.desc: Analyzed endpoint and network logs to reconstruct the attack timeline and initial access.

features.title: Containment & Remediation
